analysis.purpose: The test suite for GoExtractor — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: GoExtractor — golden (Go gate); GoExtractor — degradation + id-stability (gate); GoExtractor — Track 3 (statement/condition/CFG); GoExtractor — schema 1.2 deep-extraction fidelity (deep.go).
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of GoExtractor
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
